questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code designs the REST resource and its responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends POST .../builds/b7/cancel for a build whose status is already "cancelling". What is returned?
choices: 409 Conflict, because the build is not in a cancellable state
202 Accepted with the build, and the status is unchanged
404 Not Found, because cancel is only valid once

questions.prompt: A client calls DELETE on a build id that does not exist (or has already been deleted). What happens?
choices: 204 No Content, the same as a successful delete
